description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the EmployeeAllowedLanguageAPI class within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It tests retrieving allowed languages for an employee, including methods for getting all languages, validation rules, and handling of non-implemented delete and create operations.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedLanguageAPITest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for EmployeeAllowedLanguageAPI, testing retrieval of employee language data and validation rules.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads fixture data for testing from a YAML file.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that calling delete on the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests validation rule retrieval for delete operation.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests that create operation is not implemented and throws exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Tests validation rule retrieval for create operation.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the getAll method for retrieving employee language data, including filtering by employee number.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Tests validation rules for retrieving all allowed languages for an employee, including access control.
